def has_close_elements(numbers, threshold):
    return any(abs(x-y)<threshold for i,x in enumerate(numbers) for y in numbers[i+1:])

feature-humaneval-1.solution.py:
def separate_paren_groups(text):
    result=[]; group=""; depth=0
    for c in text:
        if c not in "()": continue
        group+=c; depth+=1 if c=="(" else -1
        if depth==0: result.append(group); group=""
    return result

feature-topk.solution.py:
from collections import Counter
def top_k(words,k):
    counts=Counter(words)
    return sorted(counts,key=lambda w:(-counts[w],w))[:max(0,k)]

def search(items,query,ignore_case=False):
    return [x for x in items if (query.lower() in x.lower() if ignore_case else query in x)]
